observable_description: CCL2/MCP-1 chemokine concentration in PDAC tumor tissue or plasma - monocyte recruitment signal
notes: Candidate for IsolatedSystemTarget on CCL2 production/degradation submodel

observable_description: TGF-β1 concentration in PDAC tumor tissue lysates or interstitial fluid (ng/mL or nM)
notes: ELISA data available in pg/mL; good submodel target candidate

observable_description: TGF-β1 concentration in peripheral blood plasma of PDAC patients
notes: No plasma TGFb species in current model; requires model extension or drop

observable_description: Interferon-gamma (IFN-γ) concentration in PDAC tumor tissue - T cell activation and M1 polarization marker
notes: Tissue concentrations rarely reported as absolute values; IHC/RNA more common

observable_description: Interleukin-10 (IL-10) concentration in PDAC tumor tissue - immunosuppressive cytokine from MDSCs and M2 macrophages
notes: Same unit-bridging challenge as IFNg; candidate for submodel target

observable_description: Interleukin-6 (IL-6) concentration in PDAC tumor tissue or plasma - pro-tumor cytokine driving MDSC recruitment and M2 polarization
notes: Plasma IL-6 ELISA data exists but model only has V_T.IL6

observable_description: Interleukin-12 (IL-12) concentration in PDAC tumor tissue - pro-inflammatory cytokine from M1 macrophages and mature DCs driving Th1 polarization and NK activation
notes: Same challenge as IFNg/IL-10; submodel candidate

observable_description: Arginase I concentration in PDAC tumor tissue - MDSC-mediated T cell suppression mechanism
notes: RNA ISH puncta data available (Menjivar 2023) but RNA-to-protein mapping problematic; consider submodel target on ArgI production/degradation or constrain indirectly via MDSC/CD8 targets

observable_description: CXCL9 (MIG) concentration in PDAC tumor tissue or expression level - CXCR3 ligand mediating CD8 T cell and NK cell recruitment to tumor
notes: More often reported as IHC/RNA than absolute concentration; submodel candidate

observable_description: CXCL12 (SDF-1) concentration in PDAC tumor tissue - produced by CAFs and cancer cells to exclude T cells via CXCR4
notes: Same challenge; submodel on CAF-derived CXCL12 production could work

observable_description: CCL5 (RANTES) concentration in PDAC tumor tissue - chemokine driving Treg recruitment via CCR5 and produced by iCAFs
notes: Same challenge; submodel on iCAF-derived CCL5 production could work

observable_description: PDGF concentration in PDAC tumor tissue - key PSC activator and CAF proliferation driver secreted by cancer cells and platelets
notes: Submodel candidate for PSC activation/CAF proliferation ODE; ELISA and IHC data available
